beats.vo: The bot will not stop itself because you hoped it would. Last page you wrote a ceiling, a cap, and a together-check. A hope is not a switch. This lesson builds one pause by hand. On the diagram for this beat, look for a hoped-for stop faded, and a hand on a switch labelled Pause. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Cross out the word hope and write Pause. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. This is not a claim that an alert will fire, or that a venue will obey it. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Hook. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

Education only, not financial advice. Crypto and DeFi carry significant risk, including total loss of capital. This is general information. This is Grid Bot Elite. The lesson is Circuit breakers done manually. Teal on the frame. Not the Blueprint plate. Education only. You will write on paper before any screen.

By the end you can tell a pause from a venue close, and you can describe one alert built by hand. A pause is your decision to stop adding to the idea. A venue close is the venue ending a position. They are different events. On the diagram for this beat, look for two columns labelled Pause and Venue close. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Write one sentence under each column. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Using one word for both events hides who acts. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Pause and venue close. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

This course does not claim a grid bot will liquidate a whole book for you. A grid is a ladder of limits. A venue close is a different machine. Do not draw them as the same button. On the diagram for this beat, look for a ladder of limits, separate from a venue-close box. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Draw the ladder and the box apart. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. A diagram that merges them teaches the wrong actor. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to The course does not liquidate the book. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

One approach is an alert at the band edge, drawn as a mark you would set yourself. No automation is installed in this lesson. The picture is a paper mark, not a live alert. On the diagram for this beat, look for a band with one mark at the edge, labelled Alert, and a note that says not installed. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Mark one edge on the example band and write: paper only. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Installing a live alert is not the assignment. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to One alert by hand. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

The action on this page is a pause on paper. You write the condition that makes you stop. You do not send a cancel, and you do not add a new order. On the diagram for this beat, look for a written if-then line: if price leaves the band, pause the idea. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Write that if-then in your own words. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. An if-then that adds size is not a pause. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to The action is a pause. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

You are here: lesson 6 of 11. The risk page is behind you. A liquidation picture is next, and it is an opt-in kind of picture. On the diagram for this beat, look for an eleven-step path with the sixth step lit. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Write the next title. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. You can understand the pause without ever opening a leveraged book. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Where you are. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

Quick check. Who acts in a pause, and who acts in a venue close? The answer: you pause the idea. The venue closes a position. On the diagram for this beat, look for the two columns with the actor named on each. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Point at the actor, not at the price. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Saying the bot will handle it is the miss. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Quiz. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.

Recap: hope is not a switch, a pause is not a venue close, and the alert in this lesson is paper. Say them without looking. On the diagram for this beat, look for three recap rows. The shapes are the lesson. If a shape is only decoration, it does not belong on this frame. Stamp Example. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. Do not recap an installed bot. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Recap. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.
